comment: task-41 (port/src/port/hdball.h): the round HD golf ball. The golfer pass of FUN_0040f5c0 draws each ball as a 2 px line (at rest on a hole) or queues a shadow and a ball sprite; FUN_00463100 draws the queued sprites. Both go through hooks (src/port/golf/ball_hooks.c) that, with ui.ball=round, measure and take out golf's own pixels and record the ball for the presenter; with ui.ball=original they make the original call. Merged into golf.json's patches by translate.py.
